title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: McIlroy’s Eighth Race to Dubai
items.text: Rory McIlroy tied the record with his eighth Race to Dubai title, dedicating it to his hospitalized father after finishing second to Tyrrell Hatton at the DP World Tour Championship.

items.headline: Tiger's PGA Tour Overhaul
items.text: Tiger Woods’ Future Competition Committee led a PGA Tour board-approved overhaul starting in 2028 that scraps PGA Tour Americas for a unified feeder system with one ranking to evolve player progression.

items.headline: PGA Tour CEO Issues LIV Warning
items.text: PGA Tour CEO Brian Rolapp warned former LIV Golf players about conditions or restrictions on any potential return to the PGA Tour following LIV’s collapse.
